en.s: The Siege of Baghdad, also known as the Sack of Baghdad, took place in early 1258. A large army commanded by Hulegu, a prince of the Mongol Empire, attacked the historic capital of the Abbasid Caliphate after a series of provocations from its ruler, caliph al-Musta'sim. Within a few weeks, Baghdad fell and was sacked by the Mongol army—al-Musta'sim was killed alongside hundreds of thousands of his subjects.
en.n: The Siege of Baghdad ends with the surrender of the last Abbasid caliph to Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire.

zh.s: 巴格达围城战也称巴格达陷落，发生于1258年初。蒙古帝国王子旭烈兀率大军进攻阿拔斯哈里发国的古都巴格达，起因是该国统治者哈里发穆斯台绥木的一系列挑衅。数周后，巴格达陷落并遭蒙古军队洗劫；穆斯台绥木及数十万臣民被杀。
zh.n: 巴格达围城战以最后一位阿拔斯王朝哈里发向蒙古帝国王子旭烈兀投降告终。

en.s: The Scottish wars (1296–1357) were two extended military conflicts in which the Kingdom of England attempted to establish control over the Kingdom of Scotland. In spite of significant temporary successes, the English efforts in both wars ultimately failed due to Scottish resistance and Scotland remained an independent country. The wars were part of a great crisis for Scotland, and the period became one of the most defining times in its history.
en.n: In front of the high altar of Greyfriars Church in Dumfries, Robert the Bruce murders John Comyn, sparking the revolution in the Wars of Scottish Independence.

zh.s: 苏格兰战争（1296—1357年）是英格兰王国试图控制苏格兰王国期间发生的两场长期战争。尽管英格兰一度取得重大进展，但最终因苏格兰人的抵抗而失败，苏格兰仍保持独立。这些战争是苏格兰经历的一场重大危机，也成为其历史上最重要的时期之一。
zh.n: 在邓弗里斯灰衣修士教堂的主祭坛前，罗伯特·布鲁斯杀死约翰·科明，由此引发苏格兰独立战争。

en.s: The Battle of Loch Ryan was a battle fought on 9/10 February 1307 during the Scottish Wars of Independence near Stranraer on Loch Ryan, Galloway, Scotland. King Robert I of Scotland's invasion of his ancestral lands in Annandale and Carrick began in 1307. The Annandale and Galloway invasion force was led by his brothers Alexander de Brus and Thomas de Brus, Malcolm McQuillan, Lord of Kintyre, an Irish sub king and Sir Reginald de Crawford. The force consisted of 1000 men and eighteen galleys. They sailed into Loch Ryan and landed near Stranraer.

zh.s: 1307年2月9日至10日，苏格兰独立战争期间，双方在苏格兰加洛韦赖恩湖畔斯特兰拉尔附近交战。苏格兰国王罗伯特一世于1307年开始进攻安嫩代尔和卡里克的祖传领地。进军安嫩代尔和加洛韦的部队由他的兄弟亚历山大·德·布鲁斯、托马斯·德·布鲁斯，以及金泰尔领主马尔科姆·麦奎兰、一名爱尔兰次级国王和雷金纳德·德·克劳福德爵士率领。部队共有1000人、18艘桨帆船，驶入赖恩湖后在斯特兰拉尔附近登陆。

en.s: Bigod's rebellion of January 1537 was an armed rebellion by English Catholics in Cumberland and Westmorland against King Henry VIII and the English Reformation Parliament. It was led by Sir Francis Bigod, of Settrington in the East Riding of Yorkshire.

en.s: The Battle of Guanging (Chinese: 廣寧之戰) was a military conflict between the Later Jin dynasty and the Ming dynasty in 1622. It occurred around the Ming's northern city of Guangning (now Beizhen, Liaoning), which fell to the Later Jin in 1622.

The Later Jin had been waging war on the Ming for several years, and their leader Nurhaci had deemed Ningyuan to be a suitable target for his attack, in part due to advice from a Ming defector, Li Yongfang.

en.s: The Battle of Tullich, also known as the Battle of the Pass near Tullich, occurred on 10 February 1654 in Tullich, Scotland during Glencairn's rising. A Royalist force led by Ewen Cameron of Lochiel, under command of Glencairn, repulsed an attack by the numerically superior Commonwealth forces of Robert Lilburne.

zh.s: 1654年2月10日，格伦凯恩起义期间，苏格兰图利赫发生战斗，也称图利赫附近隘口之战。受格伦凯恩指挥、由洛希尔的尤恩·卡梅伦率领的保王军，击退罗伯特·利尔本指挥、人数占优的英联邦军队。

en.s: The Huilliche uprising of 1712 (Spanish: Rebelión huilliche de 1712) was an Indigenous uprising against the Spanish encomenderos of the Chiloé Archipelago, which was then a part of the Captaincy General of Chile. The rebellion took place in the central part of the archipelago.

en.s: The Battle of Cape Lopez was fought in on 10 February 1722 during the Golden Age of Piracy. HMS Swallow, a British ship of the line under Captain Chaloner Ogle, defeated the pirate ship of Bartholomew Roberts off the coast of Gabon, West Africa.

zh.s: 洛佩斯角海战于1722年2月10日海盗黄金时代期间爆发。英国皇家海军“燕子”号战列舰由查洛纳·奥格尔舰长指挥，在西非加蓬海岸附近击败了巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨的海盗船。

en.s: The Treaty of Paris, also known as the Treaty of 1763, was signed on 10 February 1763 by the kingdoms of Great Britain, France and Spain, with Portugal in agreement, following Great Britain and Prussia's victory over France and Spain during the Seven Years' War.

zh.s: 1763年2月10日，七年战争中英国和普鲁士击败法国与西班牙后，英国、法国和西班牙王国签署《巴黎条约》，葡萄牙表示同意。该条约也称《1763年条约》。

en.s: On February 10, 1771, Maratha forces entered Delhi, India, taking control from Rohilla forces. The restoration of Mughal emperor Shah Alam II to Delhi followed later in the year.

en.t: 1802 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1802 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 10 February 1802. The incumbent Speaker Sir John Mitford had resigned to take office as Lord Chancellor of Ireland. Charles Abbot was proposed by Sir William Grant, Master of the Rolls, and seconded by William Baker.

zh.s: 英国下议院于1802年2月10日举行议长选举。现任议长约翰·米特福德爵士辞职，出任爱尔兰大法官。掌卷法官威廉·格兰特爵士提名查尔斯·阿博特，威廉·贝克附议。

en.s: The battle of Kasur took place on 10 February 1807 between the Sikh Empire and the Afghan-appointed governor of Kasur, and was a part of the Afghan–Sikh Wars.

en.s: The action of 10 February 1809 was a minor naval engagement of the Napoleonic Wars, in which a British Royal Navy squadron chased and captured the French frigate Junon in the Caribbean Sea. Junon was on a mission to carry trade goods from the Îles des Saintes near Guadeloupe back to France and was part of a succession of French warships sent during 1808 and the early months of 1809 in an effort to break the British blockade of the French Caribbean, which was destroying the economies and morale of the islands.

zh.s: 1809年2月10日海战是拿破仑战争期间的一场小规模海战。英国皇家海军分舰队追击并俘获法国护卫舰“朱农”号。该舰当时正从瓜德罗普附近的圣特群岛运送贸易货物返回法国，属于1808年至1809年初多艘法国军舰中的一艘，任务是打破英国对法属加勒比海地区的封锁；封锁正在破坏当地经济和士气。

en.s: The Battle of Champaubert (10 February 1814) was the opening engagement of the Six Days' Campaign. It was fought between a French army led by Napoleon and a small Russian corps commanded by Lieutenant General Count Zakhar Dmitrievich Olsufiev. After putting up a good fight, the Russian formation was effectively destroyed; the survivors escaped into the woods while Olsufiev became a French prisoner. Champaubert is located in France, 46 kilometres (29 mi) west of Châlons-en-Champagne and 69 kilometres (43 mi) east of Meaux. After defeating Emperor Napoleon at the Battle of La Rothière, the two main Allied armies under Austrian Field Marshal Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg and Prussian Field Marshal Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher separated.

zh.s: 1814年2月10日，尚波贝尔战役揭开六日战役序幕。拿破仑率法军与扎哈尔·德米特里耶维奇·奥尔苏菲耶夫伯爵中将指挥的一支俄军小型军团交战。俄军顽强抵抗后基本被歼，幸存者逃入树林，奥尔苏菲耶夫成为法军俘虏。尚波贝尔位于法国香槟沙隆以西46公里（29英里）、莫城以东69公里（43英里）。此前拿破仑在拉罗蒂埃战败，奥地利元帅施瓦岑贝格亲王卡尔·菲利普和普鲁士元帅格布哈德·莱贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔指挥的两支联军主力随后分开行动。

en.s: The Battle of Sobraon was fought on 10 February 1846, between the forces of the East India Company and the Sikh Khalsa Army. The Sikhs were completely defeated, making this the decisive battle of the First Anglo-Sikh War. The battle was a disaster for the Sikhs, with 10,000 deaths, including their general Sham Singh Attariwala.

zh.s: 索布拉翁战役于1846年2月10日爆发，交战双方是东印度公司军队和锡克卡尔萨军。锡克军惨败，这场战役也成为第一次英国—锡克战争的决定性战役。锡克军伤亡惨重，共有1万人死亡，其中包括将军沙姆·辛格·阿塔里瓦拉。

en.s: The Battle of Elizabeth City of the American Civil War was fought in the immediate aftermath of the Battle of Roanoke Island. It took place on 10 February 1862, on the Pasquotank River near Elizabeth City, North Carolina. The participants were vessels of the U.S. Navy's North Atlantic Blockading Squadron, opposed by vessels of the Confederate Navy's Mosquito Fleet; the latter were supported by a shore-based battery of four guns at Cobb's Point (now called Cobb Point), near the southeastern border of the town. The battle was a part of the campaign in North Carolina that was led by Major General Ambrose E.

zh.s: 伊丽莎白城海战发生于美国内战罗阿诺克岛战役刚结束之后，时间为1862年2月10日，地点在北卡罗来纳州伊丽莎白城附近的帕斯阔坦克河。美国海军北大西洋封锁舰队的舰艇，与联盟海军“蚊子舰队”交战；后者还得到城镇东南边缘科布角一处四门岸炮阵地支援。战斗属于北卡罗来纳战役的一部分。原文在介绍指挥该战役的安布罗斯·E.少将时中断，未给出完整姓名。

en.t: 1863 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1863 United States Senate election in California was held on February 10, 1863, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, former Democratic State Assemblyman John Conness was elected over fellow Democratic State Senator Benjamin Shurtleff.

zh.t: 1863年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1863年2月10日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的第一组联邦参议员。在一次特别联席会议上，民主党前州众议员约翰·康尼斯，击败同党的州参议员本杰明·舒特莱夫，当选联邦参议员。

en.s: The Battle of James Island (also known as the Skirmish at James Island) was a minor skirmish near the end of the American Civil War. It was known as the "Last fight for Charleston".

en.s: The Battle of Kirbekan took place during the Mahdist War. It was fought February 10, 1885, when the British Nile Column, about 1,000 strong, under General Earle, stormed the heights of Kirbekan, which were held by a strong Mahdist force, and totally routed them, with heavy loss.

en.s: The Battle of Caloocan was fought on February 10, 1899 between American forces under the command of Major General Arthur MacArthur Jr. and Filipino forces led by Brigadier-general Antonio Luna. One of the opening engagements of the Philippine–American War, the battle resulted in the Americans capturing the city of Caloocan from the Filipinos as part of an offensive planned and led by MacArthur.

zh.s: 卡卢坎战役于1899年2月10日爆发，交战双方是亚瑟·麦克阿瑟少将指挥的美军和安东尼奥·卢纳准将指挥的菲律宾军队。这是美菲战争初期的一场战斗。美军按照麦克阿瑟制定并指挥的攻势，从菲律宾军队手中攻占了卡卢坎市。

en.t: January 1910 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom over the period of and was held from 15 January to 10 February 1910, and members were returned for all 72 seats in Scotland. en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 10 February 1912. All 40 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent United Labor Party government led by Premier of South Australia John Verran was defeated by the opposition Liberal Union led by Leader of the Opposition Archibald Peake. Each of the 13 districts elected multiple members, with voters casting multiple votes.

en.s: The Battle of Dogger Bank on 10 February 1916 was a naval engagement between the Kaiserliche Marine of the German Empire and the Royal Navy of the United Kingdom, during the First World War. Three German torpedo boat flotillas sortied into the North Sea and encountered the British 10th Sloop Flotilla near Dogger Bank. The German vessels eventually engaged the British vessels, after mistaking them for cruisers instead of minesweeping sloops.

zh.s: 1916年2月10日，第一次世界大战期间，德意志帝国海军与英国皇家海军在北海多格滩附近交战。德国3支鱼雷艇舰队出航后遇到英国第10单桅帆船舰队。德国舰艇误将对方认作巡洋舰而非扫雷单桅帆船，随后与英舰交战。

en.t: Texas Tech University is founded as Texas Technological College in Lubbock, Texas
en.s: Texas Tech University (Texas Tech, TTU, or simply Tech) is a public research university in Lubbock, Texas, United States. Established in 1923 and called Texas Technological College until 1969, it is the flagship institution of the five-institution Texas Tech University System. As of fall 2025, the university enrolled 42,455 students, making it the sixth-largest university in Texas.

zh.t: 德克萨斯理工大学以德克萨斯技术学院之名创立
zh.s: 德克萨斯理工大学（简称Texas Tech、TTU或Tech）是一所位于美国德克萨斯州拉伯克市的公立研究型大学。学校于1923年创立，1969年前名为德克萨斯技术学院，是由五所院校组成的德克萨斯理工大学系统中的旗舰院校。截至2025年秋季，学校共有42,455名学生，是德克萨斯州规模第六大的大学。

en.s: The Yên Bái mutiny was an uprising of Vietnamese soldiers in the French colonial army on 10 February 1930 in collaboration with civilian supporters who were members of the Việt Nam Quốc Dân Đảng (VNQDĐ, the Vietnamese Nationalist Party). The aim of the revolt was to inspire a wider uprising among the general populace in an attempt to overthrow the colonial regime and establish independence. The VNQDĐ had previously attempted to engage in clandestine activities to undermine French rule, but increasing French scrutiny on their activities led to their leadership group taking the risk of staging a large scale military attack in the Red River Delta in northern Vietnam.

zh.s: 1930年2月10日，法国殖民军中的越南士兵，与越南国民党的平民支持者合作发动安沛起义。起义旨在带动更广泛的民众反抗，推翻殖民统治，实现独立。越南国民党此前曾通过秘密活动削弱法国统治，但法国对其监控日益严密，使领导层决定冒险，在越南北部红河三角洲发动大规模军事攻击。

en.s: The Ross and Cromarty by-election, 1936 was a parliamentary by-election for the British House of Commons constituency of Ross and Cromarty held on 10 February 1936. The by-election was triggered when Sir Ian Macpherson, a Liberal National was given a peerage. This enabled cabinet minister Malcolm MacDonald to return to Parliament.

zh.t: 1936年罗斯和克罗马蒂选区补选
zh.s: 英国下议院罗斯和克罗马蒂选区于1936年2月10日举行补选。民族自由党议员伊恩·麦克弗森爵士获封贵族，议席因此出缺。内阁大臣马尔科姆·麦克唐纳由此得以重返议会。

en.s: The Battle of Amba Aradam (also known as the Battle of Enderta) was fought on the northern front of what was known as the Second Italo-Abyssinian War. This battle consisted of attacks and counter-attacks by Italian forces under Marshal of Italy Pietro Badoglio and Ethiopian forces under Ras Mulugeta Yeggazu. This battle was primarily fought in the area around Amba Aradam which included most of Enderta Province.
en.n: Second Italo-Abyssinian War: Italian troops launch the Battle of Amba Aradam against Ethiopian defenders.

zh.s: 安巴阿拉达姆战役（又称恩德尔塔战役）发生在第二次意埃战争北线。意大利军队由意大利元帅彼得罗·巴多格里奥指挥，埃塞俄比亚军队由拉斯·穆卢盖塔·耶加祖指挥，双方在此战中多次进攻和反击。战斗主要发生在安巴阿拉达姆周边，包括恩德尔塔省的大部分地区。
zh.n: 第二次意埃战争期间，意大利军队向埃塞俄比亚守军发起安巴阿拉达姆战役。

en.t: Catalonia Offensive ends as remaining Republican units cross into France
en.s: On 10 February 1939, the last units of the Republican Army of the Ebro crossed into France, and Nationalist forces sealed the frontier, ending the Catalonia Offensive in the Spanish Civil War.
en.n: February 10 is the campaign endpoint; Barcelona had fallen on January 26.

zh.t: 加泰罗尼亚攻势结束，共和军余部撤入法国
zh.s: 1939年2月10日，共和派埃布罗集团军的最后一批部队撤入法国，国民军封锁边境，西班牙内战中的加泰罗尼亚攻势结束。
zh.n: 2月10日为此次攻势结束日期，巴塞罗那已于1月26日失守。

en.s: Operation Colossus was the codename given to the first airborne operation undertaken by the British military, which occurred on 10 February 1941 during World War II. The British airborne establishment was formed in June 1940 by the order of the British Prime Minister, Winston Churchill, in response to the successful airborne operations conducted by the German military during the Battle of France. Training began immediately, but a shortage of proper equipment and training facilities, as well as bureaucratic difficulties, meant that only a small number of volunteers could immediately be trained as parachute troops.

zh.s: “巨像”行动是英军首次空降作战的代号，发生于二战期间的1941年2月10日。德国军队在法国战役中成功实施空降行动后，英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔于1940年6月下令成立英国空降部队。训练随即开始，但因缺乏适用装备、训练设施，加上行政程序阻碍，最初只有少量志愿者能够立即接受伞兵训练。

en.s: The Battle of Kranji was the second stage of the Empire of Japan's plan for the invasion of Singapore during the Second World War. On 9 February 1942 the Imperial Japanese Army assaulted the north-western front of Singapore, capital of the Straits Settlements. Their primary objective was to secure a second beachhead after their successful assault at Sarimbun Beach on 8 February, in order to breach the Jurong-Kranji defence line as part of their southward thrust towards the heart of Singapore City.

en.s: On 10 February 1943, Soviet forces began an offensive at Krasny Bor near Leningrad, in present-day Russia, as part of Operation Polyarnaya Zvezda. Initial gains were followed by a stalemate against Spanish and German defenders.

zh.t: 苏军开始进攻克拉斯内博尔
zh.s: 1943年2月10日，苏军在列宁格勒附近的克拉斯内博尔发起进攻，这是“北极星行动”的一部分。苏军最初有所推进，随后与西班牙及德国守军陷入僵持。该地位于今俄罗斯。

en.s: Operation Polar Star (Russian: Операция Полярная звезда, Operatsia Polyarnaya Zvezda) was an operation conducted by the Soviet Leningrad, Volkhov and Northwestern Fronts in February and March 1943. The operation was planned by Georgy Zhukov in the wake of the successful Operation Iskra and envisaged two separate encirclements. One was to be carried out in the north by the Leningrad and Volkhov Fronts near Mga and one was planned to be carried out further to the south, by the Northwestern Front, near Demyansk.

zh.s: 北极星行动（俄语：Операция Полярная звезда，罗马化：Operatsia Polyarnaya Zvezda）是苏联列宁格勒方面军、沃尔霍夫方面军和西北方面军于1943年2月至3月发动的军事行动。朱可夫在伊斯卡拉行动成功后制定了作战计划，设想从南北两面实施两次包围：北面由列宁格勒方面军和沃尔霍夫方面军在姆加附近行动，南面则由西北方面军在杰米扬斯克附近行动。

en.s: The Paris Peace Treaties (French: Traités de Paris) were signed on 10 February 1947 following the end of World War II in 1945. The Paris Peace Conference lasted from 29 July until 15 October 1946. The victorious wartime Allied powers (principally the United Kingdom, Soviet Union, United States, and France) negotiated the details of peace treaties with the former (mostly minor) European Rome-Berlin-Tokyo Axis powers, namely Italy, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Finland.

zh.s: 《巴黎和约》（法语：Traités de Paris）于1947年2月10日签署，标志着第二次世界大战后和平安排的一部分。巴黎和会于1946年7月29日至10月15日举行。战时盟国（主要是英国、苏联、美国和法国）与前欧洲轴心国（主要是意大利、罗马尼亚、匈牙利、保加利亚和芬兰）谈判并确定了和约内容。

en.s: The Melbourne–Voyager collision, also referred to as the "Melbourne–Voyager incident" or simply the "Voyager incident", was a collision between two warships of the Royal Australian Navy (RAN); the aircraft carrier HMAS Melbourne (R21) and the destroyer HMAS Voyager (D04). On the evening of 10 February 1964, the two ships were performing manoeuvres off Jervis Bay. Melbourne's aircraft were performing flying exercises, and Voyager was tasked as plane guard, positioned behind and to port (left) of the carrier in order to rescue the crew of any ditching or crashing aircraft.

zh.t: “墨尔本”号与“航海者”号相撞事故
zh.s: “墨尔本”号与“航海者”号相撞事故，是澳大利亚皇家海军航空母舰“墨尔本”号（R21）与驱逐舰“航海者”号（D04）之间的撞舰事故，也称航海者事件。1964年2月10日晚，两舰在杰维斯湾外海演习。“墨尔本”号舰载机进行飞行训练，“航海者”号担任飞行救援警戒舰，位于航母左后方，负责营救迫降海面或坠毁飞机的机组人员。

en.t: Twenty-fifth Amendment to the US Constitution ratified
en.s: On February 10, 1967, the Twenty-fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution gained the required 38 state ratifications. It clarified presidential succession and established procedures for filling a vice-presidential vacancy and addressing presidential inability.

zh.t: 美国宪法第二十五修正案获足够州批准

en.s: General elections were held in Burma between 27 January and 10 February 1974. They were the first under the new constitution approved in a referendum the previous year. This had made the country a one-party state with the Burma Socialist Programme Party as the sole legal party. It therefore won all 451 seats in the People's Assembly. Voter turnout was reported to be 94.6%.

zh.s: 缅甸于1974年1月27日至2月10日举行大选，是前一年公投通过新宪法后首次举行的选举。新宪法使该国成为一党制国家，缅甸社会主义纲领党是唯一合法政党，因此赢得人民议会全部451席。据公布的数据，投票率为94.6%。

en.s: The Wagalla massacre was a massacre of ethnic Somalis by the Kenyan Army on 10 February 1984 in Wajir County, Kenya. The massacre started as an effort to neutralize the ethnic Degodia clan following clan-related conflict in the region populated by Kenyan-Somalis. Government troops were ordered to stop clan violence in the area, and did so by first detaining some 5,000 locals at an airstrip, denying them food and water for a week, and then shooting them. The massacre was not investigated by Kenya's government until 2011.

zh.s: 1984年2月10日，肯尼亚军队在瓦吉尔县屠杀索马里族人，史称瓦加拉大屠杀。该地区索马里裔居民发生氏族冲突后，军方试图压制德戈迪亚氏族。奉命制止冲突的政府军，先将约5000名当地人拘禁在一座机场，一周不给食物和饮水，随后向他们开枪。肯尼亚政府直到2011年才调查这场屠杀。

en.s: The First Battle of al-Faw was a battle of the Iran–Iraq War, fought on the al-Faw peninsula between 10 February and 10 March 1986. The Iranian operation is considered to be one of Iran's greatest achievements in the Iran–Iraq War. The Iranians were able to capture the al-Faw peninsula, cutting off Iraqi access to the Persian Gulf in the process; this in turn hardened Iraqi attitudes to prosecute the war.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于2004年2月10日举行民主党总统初选，是当年美国民主党总统初选的一部分，所有选民均可参加。该州98个代表名额中的82个按候选人得票比例分配，候选人须达到15%的得票门槛才有资格分得名额。

en.s: Kish Air Flight 7170 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Kish Island in Iran to Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, operated by Iranian airline Kish Air. On February 10, 2004, the aircraft serving the route, a Fokker 50, lost control and crashed onto terrain while on approach to Sharjah International Airport. A total of 43 out of 46 people on board were killed in the crash, making it the deadliest air disaster involving the Fokker 50.

zh.s: 基什航空7170号班机是伊朗基什航空运营的定期国际客运航班，从伊朗基什岛飞往阿拉伯联合酋长国沙迦。2004年2月10日，执行航班的一架福克50在接近沙迦国际机场时失控坠地，机上46人中有43人死亡，是涉及福克50型飞机死亡人数最多的空难。

en.s: The 2004 Tennessee Democratic presidential primary was held on February 10 in the U.S. state of Tennessee as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 2004 presidential election. The primary determined 69 delegates to the 2004 Democratic National Convention, who were awarded on a proportional basis. John Kerry won with 41.02% of the vote and was awarded 31 delegates.

zh.t: 2004年田纳西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2004年田纳西州民主党总统初选于2月10日在美国田纳西州举行，是民主党在2004年总统选举前举行的全州提名选举之一。初选将69名代表送往2004年民主党全国代表大会，代表按比例分配。约翰·克里以41.02%的得票率获胜，获得31名代表。

en.s: The 2006 Africa Cup of Nations final was a football match that took place on 10 February 2006 at the Cairo International Stadium in Cairo, Egypt to determine the winner of the 2006 Africa Cup of Nations, the football championship of African nations organised by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). Egypt won their fifth-ever AFCON after defeating the Ivory Coast 4–2 on penalties.

zh.s: 2006年非洲国家杯决赛于2006年2月10日在埃及开罗国际体育场举行，决出该届非洲足球锦标赛冠军。埃及队在点球大战中以4比2击败科特迪瓦队，第五次夺得非洲国家杯冠军。

en.s: EliteXC: Destiny was the inaugural mixed martial arts event by the mixed martial arts organization EliteXC. The event took place on Saturday, February 10, 2007 at the DeSoto Civic Center in Southaven, Mississippi. The main card aired on Showtime, with the undercard was streamed live on the Proelite.com website.

zh.s: “EliteXC：命运之战”是综合格斗组织EliteXC举办的首场赛事，于2007年2月10日星期六在美国密西西比州南海文德索托市政中心举行。主赛部分由Showtime播出，垫场赛则在Proelite.com网站直播。

en.s: On February 10, 2007, the first Strikeforce: Young Guns event took place at San Jose Civic Auditorium in San Jose, California, United States.

zh.s: 2007年2月10日，Strikeforce首届Young Guns综合格斗赛在美国加利福尼亚州圣何塞市政礼堂举行。

en.s: Against All Odds (2008) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on February 10, 2008 at the BI-LO Center in Greenville, South Carolina. It was the fourth event under the Against All Odds chronology and the second event in the 2008 TNA PPV schedule. Nine professional wrestling matches were featured on the event's card, four of which involved championships, while two matches were held prior to the event. The main event was for the TNA World Heavyweight Championship with Samoa Joe as Special Outside Enforcer between then-champion Kurt Angle and the challenger Christian Cage.

zh.s: 2008年逆境之战是全非停行动摔角（TNA）举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2月10日在美国南卡罗来纳州格林维尔BI-LO中心举行。这是第四届同名赛事，也是TNA当年第二场按次付费赛事。正式节目安排九场比赛，其中四场争夺冠军，开场前另有两场比赛。主赛由时任冠军科特·安格对阵挑战者克里斯蒂安·凯奇，争夺TNA世界重量级冠军，萨摩亚·乔担任场外特别执法员。

en.s: The 2008 Leadership election of Synaspismos took place on 10 February 2008, during its 5th Congress. The two candidates were: Alexis Tsipras and Fotis Kouvelis. Tsipras won with 840 votes, while Kouvelis earned 342 votes, while 14 members voted blank or invalid.

zh.t: 2008年希腊左翼联盟领导人选举
zh.s: 希腊左翼联盟于2008年2月10日第五届代表大会期间举行领导人选举，候选人为阿莱克西斯·齐普拉斯和福蒂斯·库韦利斯。齐普拉斯获得840票，击败取得342票的库韦利斯，另有14票为空白票或无效票。

en.s: The 2008 Africa Cup of Nations final was a football match that took place on 10 February 2008 at the Ohene Djan Stadium in Accra, Ghana to determine the winner of the 2008 Africa Cup of Nations, the football championship of African national teams organised by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). It was contested between Cameroon and Egypt. Egypt defeated Cameroon 1–0 to win their sixth title.

zh.s: 2008年非洲国家杯决赛于2月10日在加纳阿克拉奥赫内·詹体育场举行，由喀麦隆与埃及争夺冠军。这项非洲国家队足球锦标赛由非洲足联主办。埃及以1比0击败喀麦隆，第六次夺冠。

en.s: The 2008 Maine Democratic presidential caucuses took place on February 10, 2008, and had 24 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Maine's two congressional districts received all of that district's total delegates, which totaled 16. Another eight delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama, at the Maine Democratic Party Statewide Convention on May 31, 2008.

zh.t: 2008年缅因州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 缅因州于2008年2月10日举行民主党总统党团会议，争夺24个代表名额。原文记载，两个国会选区的胜者各获得该区全部名额，合计16个；另外八个名额在5月31日的州民主党大会上，分配给全州胜者贝拉克·奥巴马。

en.s: The 2008 Liga Indonesia Premier Division final was a football match which was played on 10 February 2008 at Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung. The match was supposed to take place on 9 February 2008 in Jakarta. However, due to fan riots in one of the semifinal matches, the match was postponed by a day and moved to Bandung to be played behind closed doors.

zh.s: 2008年印尼甲级联赛决赛于2008年2月10日在万隆的西贾拉克·哈鲁帕特体育场举行。比赛原定于2月9日在雅加达举行，但一场半决赛发生球迷骚乱后，决赛延期一天并改至万隆举行，且闭门进行。

en.s: On February 10, 2008, an arsonist set fire to the historic Namdaemun gate (officially "Sungnyemun") in Seoul, South Korea, causing severe damage to the 550-year-old structure. The monument was restored and reopened to the public in 2013.

zh.s: 2008年2月10日，一名纵火者在韩国首尔点燃历史悠久的崇礼门（官方名称：崇礼门），造成这座有550年历史的建筑严重受损。该古迹经过修复，于2013年重新向公众开放。

en.s: The 2009 Fort Lauderdale mayoral election took place on February 10, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Jim Naugle was term limited and could not seek a seventh term in office. Four candidates ran to replace him: State Representative Jack Seiler, former City Commissioner Dean Trantalis, businessman Earl Rynerson, and attorney Steve Rossi. Seiler emerged as the frontrunner, and earned the endorsements of the Miami Herald and the Sun Sentinel.

zh.s: 劳德代尔堡于2009年2月10日举行市长选举。现任市长吉姆·诺格尔受任期限制，不能争取第七个任期。四名候选人竞逐继任：州众议员杰克·赛勒、前市委员迪恩·特兰塔利斯、商人厄尔·赖纳森及律师史蒂夫·罗西。赛勒成为领先者，并获得《迈阿密先驱报》和《太阳哨兵报》支持。

en.s: The 27th Fajr International Film Festival (Persian: بیست و هفتمین جشنواره بین‌المللی فیلم فجر) held from 31 January to 10 February 2009 in Tehran, Iran. Doubt (Varuzh Karim-Masihi, 2009) — which adapted from Shakespeare's Hamlet — was the festival's best film in "Competition of Iranian Cinema" and Snow (Aida Begić, 2008), a Bosnian film, was the festival's best film in "Competition of International Cinema".

zh.s: 第27届曙光国际电影节于2009年1月31日至2月10日在伊朗德黑兰举行。瓦鲁日·卡里米-马西希执导的《疑惑》（2009年）改编自莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》，获伊朗电影竞赛单元最佳影片；波黑影片《雪》（艾达·贝吉奇执导，2008年）获国际电影竞赛单元最佳影片。

en.s: The 2012 Saudi Crown Prince Cup final was the 37th final of the Crown Prince Cup, a football tournament. It took place on 10 February 2012 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and was contested between Al-Hilal and Al-Ettifaq. It was Al-Hilal's 12th Crown Prince Cup final and Al-Ettifaq's fifth final. This was the second meeting between these two clubs in the final after 2008.

zh.s: 第37届沙特王储杯足球赛决赛于2012年2月10日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得法赫德国王国际体育场举行，由利雅得新月对阵达曼协作。这是新月第12次、协作第五次进入王储杯决赛，也是两队继2008年后第二次在决赛交锋。

en.s: The 2013 Africa Cup of Nations final was a football match that took place on 10 February 2013 to determine the winner of the 2013 Africa Cup of Nations, the football championship of Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). The match was held at the FNB Stadium in Johannesburg which also hosted the 1996 Africa Cup of Nations Final and the 2010 FIFA World Cup Final.

zh.s: 2013年非洲国家杯决赛于2013年2月10日举行，决出该届非洲足球锦标赛冠军。比赛在约翰内斯堡的FNB体育场举行，该场馆也承办过1996年非洲国家杯决赛和2010年国际足联世界杯决赛。

en.s: The 2013 Indonesian Community Shield was the third Indonesian Community Shield. The match was contested by the 2011–12 Indonesian Premier League winners Semen Padang FC and 2012 Piala Indonesia winners Persibo Bojonegoro. It took place on 10 February 2013 at the Haji Agus Salim Stadium in Padang, Indonesia. Semen Padang won the match 4–1.

zh.s: 2013年印度尼西亚社区盾杯是该项赛事的第三届比赛，由2011—12赛季印度尼西亚超级联赛冠军塞门巴东队对阵2012年印度尼西亚杯冠军博佐内戈罗队。比赛于2013年2月10日在印度尼西亚巴东的哈吉·阿古斯·萨利姆体育场举行，塞门巴东队以4比1获胜。

en.s: The 2015 Fort Lauderdale mayoral election took place on February 10, 2015. Incumbent Mayor Jack Seiler ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by bartender Chris Brennan and tile company owner Earl Rynerson, who previously ran against Seiler in 2009 and 2012. In a low-visibility election, Seiler defeated both in a landslide, winning 71 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 劳德代尔堡于2015年2月10日举行市长选举。现任市长杰克·赛勒争取第三个任期，对手为调酒师克里斯·布伦南及瓷砖公司老板厄尔·赖纳森，后者曾在2009年和2012年与赛勒竞争。这场选举关注度不高，赛勒以71%的得票率取得压倒性胜利。

en.s: The 2015 Supercopa Argentina Final was the 4th edition of the Supercopa, an annual football match contested by the winners of the Argentine Primera División and Copa Argentina competitions. Because Boca Juniors had won both competitions, San Lorenzo, the runners-up to the Argentine Primera División, were selected as the other finalist of Supercopa Argentina. San Lorenzo beat Boca Juniors 4–0 in Córdoba and won the trophy.

zh.s: 2015年阿根廷超级杯决赛是该赛事的第4届比赛，每年由阿根廷甲级联赛和阿根廷杯的冠军球队进行一场比赛。由于博卡青年同时赢得两项赛事，阿根廷甲级联赛亚军圣洛伦索被选为另一支决赛球队。圣洛伦索在科尔多瓦以4比0击败博卡青年，夺得冠军。

en.t: CMLL Torneo Nacional de Parejas Increíbles (2017)
en.s: The CMLL Torneo Nacional de Parejas Increíbles 2017 or "National Incredible Pairs Tournament 2017" was a tag team Lucha Libre tournament held by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). The tournament is based on the Lucha Libre Parejas Increíbles match concept, which pairs two wrestlers of opposite allegiance, one portraying a villain, referred to as a "rudo" in Lucha Libre wrestling terminology, and one portraying a fan favorites, or "técnico".

zh.t: CMLL 2017年全国奇妙双打锦标赛
zh.s: CMLL 2017年全国奇妙双打锦标赛是由墨西哥摔角推广组织世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的摔角双打锦标赛。比赛采用“奇妙双打”赛制：两名立场相反的摔角手组成一队，其中一人扮演反派（rudo），另一人则扮演观众喜爱的正派角色（técnico）。

en.s: The 2017 Egyptian Super Cup was the 14th edition of the Egyptian Super Cup, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Egyptian Premier League and Egypt Cup. The match is usually contested by the winners of the Premier League and the Egypt Cup, Al Ahly won the 2015–16 Egyptian Premier League, Zamalek won the 2016 Egypt Cup.

zh.s: 2017年埃及超级杯是该赛事的第14届比赛，每年由上赛季埃及超级联赛和埃及杯的冠军球队对阵。比赛通常由这两项赛事的冠军参加；阿赫利赢得2015—16赛季埃及超级联赛，扎马雷克赢得2016年埃及杯。

en.s: On 10 February 2018, at approximately 18:13 HKT, a Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) double-decker bus flipped onto its side on Tai Po Road in Tai Po, New Territories. The crash killed 19 people and injured 65. The incident, also known as the 872 accident (Chinese: 872意外) after the number of the route the bus was traveling on, was Hong Kong's second-deadliest road traffic accident, behind a 2003 incident on Tuen Mun Road which killed 21.

zh.s: 2018年2月10日香港时间约18时13分，九巴一辆双层巴士在新界大埔的大埔公路侧翻，造成19人死亡、65人受伤。事故也按巴士线路编号被称为872意外，是香港死亡人数第二多的道路交通事故，仅次于2003年屯门公路造成21人死亡的事故。

en.s: Local elections were held in Sri Lanka on 10 February 2018. 15.7 million Sri Lankans were eligible to elect 8,327 members to 340 local authorities (24 municipal councils, 41 urban councils and 275 divisional councils). It was the largest election in Sri Lankan history. This was also the first election under the mixed electoral system where 60% of members were elected using first-past-the-post voting and the remaining 40% through closed list proportional representation.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2018年2月10日举行地方选举，1570万名合资格选民选出340个地方机构的8327名成员，包括24个市议会、41个城镇议会及275个分区议会。这是斯里兰卡历史上规模最大的选举，也是首次采用混合选制：60%的席位以得票最多者当选的方式选出，其余40%采用封闭名单比例代表制。

en.t: 2018 United States Soccer Federation presidential election
en.s: The 2018 United States Soccer Federation presidential election was held in February 2018 to determine the next President of the United States Soccer Federation. Having served as President since 2006, incumbent Sunil Gulati decided not to run for re-election, after the United States men's national soccer team failed to qualify for the FIFA World Cup for the first time since 1986.

zh.t: 2018年美国足球联合会主席选举
zh.s: 2018年美国足球联合会主席选举于当年2月举行，以选出下一任主席。自2006年起担任主席的孙宜兰决定不再竞选连任，此前美国男子国家足球队自1986年以来首次无缘国际足联世界杯。

en.s: On 10 February 2018, an Israeli F-16 was shot down by the Syrian air defenses after conducting an air raid on Iran-backed positions inside Syrian territory. The aircraft was part of a larger Israeli aerial dispatch which Israel said was sent in response to detection of an Iranian drone spying on Israel. Two hours after the downing of the jet, Israel began attacking additional targets inside Syria, including air defense sites and Iranian targets near Damascus.

zh.s: 2018年2月10日，以色列一架F-16战机在空袭叙利亚境内受伊朗支持的目标后，被叙利亚防空部队击落。以色列称，这次空袭是为了回应发现一架伊朗无人机在以色列境内侦察。战机被击落约两小时后，以色列开始袭击叙利亚境内的其他目标，包括防空阵地和大马士革附近的伊朗目标。

en.s: The 2018 Xerox Super Cup was held on 10 February 2018 between the 2017 J1 League champions Kawasaki Frontale and the 2017 Emperor's Cup winner Cerezo Osaka. Cerezo won the title after winning 3–2.

zh.s: 2018年施乐超级杯于2月10日举行，由2017年J1联赛冠军川崎前锋对阵2017年天皇杯冠军大阪樱花。大阪樱花以3比2获胜，夺得冠军。

en.s: The 2019 Abruzzo regional election took place on 10 February 2019. The election was for all 29 elected seats of the Regional Council of Abruzzo as well as the President of the region who, along with the second placed presidential candidate, would also become members of the Regional Council. The ballot resulted in the election of Marco Marsilio, the centre-right candidate, as President of the Regional Council with 48% of the votes.

zh.s: 阿布鲁佐大区于2019年2月10日举行选举，改选大区议会全部29个民选席位，并选出大区主席。排名第二的主席候选人也会成为大区议会议员。中右翼候选人马尔科·马尔西利奥以48%的选票当选大区议会主席。

en.t: Clashes begin in the Aneet–Abyei area
en.s: On February 10, 2022, fighting broke out in the Aneet–Abyei area involving Twic Dinka and Ngok Dinka groups amid a dispute over land and a market. The conflict continued beyond this first attack.

zh.t: 阿内特—阿卜耶伊地区爆发冲突
zh.s: 2022年2月10日，特维克丁卡人与恩戈克丁卡人在阿内特—阿卜耶伊地区因土地及市场争议爆发冲突，战斗此后仍在持续。

en.s: The 72nd annual Berlin International Film Festival, usually called the Berlinale (German pronunciation: [bɛʁliˈnaːlə] ), took place from 10 to 20 February 2022 in person. On 15 December 2021, the first film of the festival was announced. The festival opened with François Ozon's drama film Peter von Kant. Isabelle Huppert was awarded Honorary Golden Bear for lifetime achievement on 15 February 2022 at the Berlinale Palast award ceremony.

zh.s: 第72届柏林国际电影节（通常称为柏林电影节）于2022年2月10日至20日线下举行。电影节首部影片于2021年12月15日公布，开幕影片是弗朗索瓦·欧容执导的剧情片《彼得·冯·康德》。伊莎贝尔·于佩尔于2022年2月15日在柏林电影节宫颁奖典礼上获颁终身成就荣誉金熊奖。

en.s: Super Series (2023) was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), in conjunction with Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) and Promociones EMW (EMW). It took place on February 10, 2023, at Auditorio Fausto Gutierrez Moreno in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico. It was the third event in the MLW Super Series chronology, following the 2022 event in Georgia, and served as a television taping for the new season of MLW Fusion that premiered on May 25, 2023.

zh.s: 2023年超级系列赛是职业摔角大联盟（MLW）联合AAA全球摔角组织及EMW推广公司举办的大型职业摔角赛事，于2月10日在墨西哥下加利福尼亚州蒂华纳的福斯托·古铁雷斯·莫雷诺礼堂举行。这是继2022年佐治亚州赛事后的第三届MLW超级系列赛，并用于录制新一季《MLW Fusion》，该季节目于2023年5月25日首播。

en.s: The 2023 AFC Asian Cup final was a football match which determined the winner of the 2023 AFC Asian Cup, the 18th edition of the AFC Asian Cup, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of the Asian Football Confederation. en.s: The 2023 Bulgarian Supercup was the 20th edition of the Bulgarian Supercup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's First League and the Bulgarian Cup. The game was played between the champions of the 2022–23 First League, Ludogorets Razgrad, and the 2023 Bulgarian Cup runners-up, CSKA 1948, since Ludogorets won both trophies. This was Ludogorets's 11th Supercup appearance and CSKA 1948's first.

zh.s: 2023年保加利亚超级杯是该赛事的第20届比赛，由上赛季保加利亚甲级联赛和保加利亚杯的冠军球队对阵。比赛双方是2022—23赛季甲级联赛冠军卢多戈雷茨和2023年保加利亚杯亚军索菲亚中央陆军1948队，因为卢多戈雷茨赢得了两项赛事的冠军。卢多戈雷茨第11次参加超级杯，索菲亚中央陆军1948队则是首次参赛。

en.s: On February 10, 2026, a mass shooting occurred in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Canada. On that afternoon, Jesse Van Rootselaar killed her mother and half-brother at their home before going to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, where she killed six people and injured 27 others before killing herself. Van Rootselaar was a former student of the school.

zh.s: 2026年2月10日，加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省坦布勒里奇发生大规模枪击案。当天下午，杰西·范鲁特塞拉尔在家中杀害母亲及同母异父兄弟，随后前往自己曾就读的坦布勒里奇中学，杀死六人、打伤27人后自杀。
